g.text: Sequence diagram — AI assistance (1/2): maintenance ticket triage
[invented value, no answer, or no key]
403 for a renter whose company neither booked nor leased the space;
otherwise ticket ASSIGNED (assignee given) or OPEN, space MAINTENANCE
if URGENT or EMERGENCY, assignee notified and e-mailed.
The model proposes; it never decides. The technician
comes from ticket history, and submitting a ticket
